errors.text_span: 水平轴表示知识表示方法
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is labeled "基座模型" (Base Model), not "知识表示方法" (knowledge representation methods). The legend categories represent the knowledge representation methods.
The description incorrectly appends the x-axis label, "基座模型" (Base Model), to the category name "Bioformer". The category label on the chart is simply "Bioformer".

errors.text_span: 每个类别内有五个柱状图
errors.evidence: There are six bars within each category group (BioBERT, Bioformer, PubMedBERT), not five.
The description omits the "TransR" category, which is present in the legend and represented by a yellow bar in each group.

The description incorrectly maps the category "TransE" to the color "淡黄色" (light yellow). In the figure, the light yellow bar corresponds to "TransR", while "TransE" is represented by a tan/orange bar.
For the BioBERT category, the value for "TransE" is 0.753. The value 0.757 corresponds to the "TransR" bar. The description incorrectly assigns TransR's value to TransE.

errors.text_span: 在 Bioformer 基座模型类别中，柱状图分别表示为 0.720、0.732、0.748、0.746、0.741。
errors.evidence: This list of values for the Bioformer group is incorrect. It omits one value (0.730 for "Random") and the order of the listed values is jumbled, not matching the order of the bars in the chart.
This list of values for the PubMedBERT group is incorrect. It omits one value (0.741 for "ConvE") and swaps the order of the first two values (0.743 for Original and 0.734 for Random).

errors.text_span: 使得每个知识表示方法在每个类别中相对比较容易
errors.evidence: This phrase is an interpretation of the chart's design purpose ('makes it relatively easy to compare'), which is supposed to be avoided according to the prompt instructions.
